summary: eXoZymes Inc. filed an 8-K on June 17, 2026, reporting the closing of a firm-commitment underwritten offering and partial exercise of the over-allotment option. The company issued 592,270 shares and warrants to purchase 296,135 shares as units at $18.00 per unit, plus 68,880 additional shares and 34,440 warrants via over-allotment. Gross proceeds totaled approximately $5.95 million. The offering was conducted through underwriter MDB Capital under an effective shelf registration statement. Net proceeds will fund development of N-trans-caffeoyltyramine, R&D, and general corporate purposes. This is a routine capital raising event, not a special situation.
